note: Staging catalog for synthetic agent-trace corpus. Verification column reflects package-existence probes run 2026-08-08 (npm view / PyPI JSON API / unauthenticated MCP initialize POST). No servers were actually launched, so est_tool_count comes from upstream docs, not a live tools/list.

servers.name: filesystem
servers.purpose: Sandboxed read/write file operations restricted to allow-listed directories.

servers.name: memory
servers.purpose: Knowledge-graph persistent memory backed by a JSONL file (entities, relations, observations).

servers.name: sequential-thinking
servers.purpose: Structured step-by-step reasoning scratchpad; one tool called repeatedly within a task.

servers.name: everything
servers.purpose: Official reference/test server. Deliberately exercises long-running operations, server-initiated sampling, elicitation, image results, resource links, and log spam. Highest-value server for trace variety.

servers.name: git
servers.purpose: Read, search, and manipulate a local git repository (status, diff, log, commit, branch, checkout).
servers.warning: PyPI-only. The npm package literally named 'mcp-server-git' (v0.0.2) is a different, unofficial package - do not launch this via npx.

servers.name: fetch
servers.purpose: Fetch a URL and extract its contents as markdown. Respects robots.txt unless --ignore-robots-txt is passed.
servers.warning: PyPI-only. The npm package literally named 'mcp-server-fetch' (v0.0.2) is a different, unofficial package - do not launch this via npx.

servers.name: time
servers.purpose: Current time and timezone conversion. Cheapest server in the set; useful as a baseline MCP startup cost.

servers.name: context7
servers.auth_note: Works keyless at a reduced rate limit; an API key (Authorization: Bearer) only raises the limit. Unauthenticated initialize POST returned HTTP 200 on 2026-08-08.
servers.purpose: Live up-to-date library/framework documentation lookup. The only remote server here that actually connects, so it supplies the real network-transport latency in the corpus.

servers.name: github
servers.auth_note: Requires OAuth or a GitHub PAT. Unauthenticated initialize POST returned HTTP 401 on 2026-08-08.
servers.tool_count_source: rough estimate from vendor tool docs; NOT verified against a live tools/list
servers.purpose: INTENTIONALLY UNAUTHENTICATED. Included so the corpus contains a realistic MCP auth-failure startup path (HTTP 401). Set enabled = false to remove it.

rejected.name: sqlite
rejected.reason: Archived from the reference repo; @modelcontextprotocol/server-sqlite does not exist on npm. PyPI mcp-server-sqlite still resolves but is unmaintained in servers-archived.

rejected.name: playwright
rejected.reason: Very popular (@playwright/mcp v0.0.79, ~22 tools, no auth) but launches a real browser - heavy startup and non-representative latency for this corpus. Add deliberately if browser traces are wanted.

rejected.name: slack / gdrive / postgres / puppeteer
rejected.reason: Archived from the reference repo and/or require paid or org credentials.
